**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/27 (Sat) 13:58

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Use Case 1: Customer requests a refund for a game purchased on Steam

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Actor: Customer

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Use Case Overview: A customer wants to request a refund for a game they purchased on Steam. They navigate to the refund page, select the game they want to refund, and submit the refund request. Steam reviews the request and processes the refund.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Subject Area: Online Gaming

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Actor(s): The customer

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Trigger: The customer wants to request a refund for a game they purchased on Steam.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Precondition 1: The customer has a Steam account.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Precondition 2: The game the customer wants to refund was purchased within the last 14 days.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Basic Flow: Request Refund

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Customer navigates to the refund page on Steam.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Customer selects the game they want to refund from their purchase history.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Customer submits the refund request and provides a reason for the refund.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Steam reviews the request and verifies the purchase history and refund policy.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Steam processes the refund and updates the customer's account balance.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Steam sends an email to the customer with the refund details.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. The customer's account balance is updated with the refunded amount.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Termination outcome: The customer has successfully requested a refund for the game and the refund has been processed.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Alternative Flow 2A: Refund request denied

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Description: This scenario describes the situation where the refund request is denied.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2A1. Steam reviews the request and verifies the purchase history and refund policy.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2A2. Steam denies the refund request and informs the customer of the reason.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2A3. The customer can appeal the decision, providing additional information.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Termination outcome: The refund request is denied, and the customer is informed of the reason.
